name: Firebase Runner
description: Experiment runner for hosting web-based experiments on Firebase and collecting participant responses via Firestore.

parameters.name: time_out
parameters.description: Timeout duration in seconds for resetting unfinished conditions.

parameters.name: sleep_time
parameters.description: Interval in seconds between Firebase database status checks.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Experimental conditions to present to participants.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: Participant responses collected from the experiment.
